description: Couche de signature visuelle décorative — cohérente, intentionnelle, systémique
philosophy: PEU d'éléments, utilisés UNIFORMÉMENT. Jamais d'accumulation décorative. La cohérence EST le design.

function.name: generate_visual_decorators
function.input: VisualIntent produit par visual_intent_engine (champs utilisés : context.emotional_goal, context.brand_positioning, art_direction.style_family, art_direction.intensity, composition_bias.density)
function.output: dict strict — 5 clés : borders, dividers, icons, motifs, overlays

borders.style: none | solid | dashed | double | glow | dotted

dividers.type: none | line | space | ornament | gradient | zigzag

motifs.type: none | geometric | blob | grid-fragment | diagonal-cut | noise | dot-pattern | line-pattern | wave

overlays.type: none | gradient | noise | duotone | vignette | scanlines

priority_logic.1_style_family: Si style_family connue → override complet (prime sur tout)
priority_logic.4_intensity: low → retire motifs/overlays ; high → peut ajouter overlay léger

presets.trust: solid thin, line minimal, icons line sharp simple, no motifs, no overlays
presets.excitement: glow medium, zigzag bold, icons filled sharp medium, diagonal-cut, scanlines
presets.desire: solid thin radius-medium, gradient subtle, icons duotone rounded, blob background
presets.calm: solid thin radius-large, space subtle, icons line rounded simple, wave background
presets.curiosity: dashed thin, ornament decorative, icons outline-filled mixed, grid-fragment
presets.authority: solid medium top-only, line bold, icons filled sharp, geometric corner
presets.default: solid thin small, line minimal, icons line rounded simple

style_family_overrides.editorial_luxury: double thin frame, line decorative, icons line sharp simple, aucun motif
style_family_overrides.brutalist: solid thick frame, line bold, icons filled sharp, grid-fragment full-bleed
style_family_overrides.tech_minimal: solid thin top-only, line minimal, icons line sharp, dot-pattern background
style_family_overrides.experimental_grid: dashed medium, zigzag decorative, icons outline-filled mixed detailed, grid-fragment, noise
style_family_overrides.premium_brand: solid thin frame, line decorative, icons duotone rounded, gradient overlay
style_family_overrides.bold_marketing: solid thick frame, gradient bold, icons filled rounded medium, diagonal-cut

integration.renderer: Applique borders identiques sur tous les composants. Même style icon partout. Motif réutilisé en pattern sur toutes les sections.
